description: Harris Central Appraisal District certified rolls for tax years 2022 to 2025 (one source per year). See docs/registry/texas-sources.md, 'Prior-year rolls'.

sources.license: Public record (Tex. Gov't Code ch. 552); no license or terms of use stated for the downloads
sources.redistribution: Not addressed by the publisher; public record
sources.notes: Prior-year certified roll, tax year 2022: same host, path family (data/CAMA/<year>/) and file names as the 2026 files of tx-harris-cad, whose terms were reviewed 2026-11-02 (not re-read for this entry). HEAD 2026-11-10: all 200, Last-Modified 2026-11-09 (HCAD regenerated the prior-year folders on 2026-11-01 and again on 2026-11-09, so values may carry later corrections); Real_acct_owner 198,362,397 B, Real_building_land 192,940,974 B, Real_jur_exempt 104,986,999 B, Code_description_real 170,690 B. get-certification-flag?t=2022 answers certflg Y. Real_acct_ownership_history.zip is 404 for 2022 (only the current year has it); PP_files.zip and Hearing_files.zip are not listed here. File layout not opened (about 2.1 GB for the four years); sizes grow smoothly 2022 to 2026, so the same layout is expected. hcad.org robots.txt now carries 'Crawl-Delay: 3' (the collector honours it); download.hcad.org has no robots.txt (404). Older years (2005 to 2021) are listed by get-tax-years but not configured.
